result.summary: Several visual and layout issues: truncated restaurant names, duplicate cards with identical content, cut-off category pills, and incomplete promotional/list items that make the UI look broken or unfinished.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Smash Bros Bu' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section.
issues.suggestion: Allow text to wrap, use a smaller font, or truncate with ellipsis and ensure full name is available on the detail view; widen the card or adjust layout so names fit.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards appear side by side with the same image, delivery time, and price, which looks like a data or rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate list items and ensure each card shows a distinct restaurant or offer.

issues.description: Category filter row is clipped on the right; the last visible pill ('Healthy') and any further categories are partially cut off with no clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll indicator, padding, or ensure pills fully fit / fade to show more content is available.

issues.description: Bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is heavily cropped; only the top portion of the image and discount badge are visible, making the section feel incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Ensure cards have consistent height and enough viewport space, or adjust scroll so at least one full card plus a peek of the next is shown cleanly.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' (burger) is partially off-screen, consistent with a horizontal list that doesn’t clearly communicate overflow.
issues.suggestion: Add peek of next card with consistent spacing and optional scroll hint so truncation doesn’t look accidental.
